card.name: Words before a single or one thing
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs just before a word meaning one or a single (single, one, a biggest), in general explanatory web text. It also fires on a few words in a kidnapping story.

modes.label: Before 'a single' or 'one'

modes.example: In Unix, each file belongs to a single user<< and>> a single group.

modes.label: Kidnapping story
